title: VeriCoT: Neuro-symbolic Chain-of-Thought Validation via Logical Consistency Checks

scope.included: 官方ICLR终稿§3.3–3.4现成Claude推理期符号反馈后一次修正及错误类型比较。
scope.excluded: 排除Qwen的SFT/DPO支路；本记录证据优先官方终稿文本。
scope.study_summary: 现成Claude生成CoT后接受符号验证器的逐步错误反馈，再修正并重评；并列比较验证通过、错误类别及答案正确。
scope.scope_basis: 冻结交付的最终reason/review及qualification_scope；候选字段仅作定位，事实定向核原文

reading.limits: 逐篇核查已纳入研究单元及其直接支撑方法，引用段落实际读取；未声称全篇全部实验重新阅读或验收。

models in producing better CoTs at inference time. Our process is as follows: if a CoT fails to pass
the verification check, we prompt the model to self-correct its reasoning. We adopt two variants (Base,

Inference-time Self-reflection. We first evaluate whether V ERI C OT feedback can be used to guide
models in producing better CoTs at inference time. Our process is as follows: if a CoT fails to pass
the verification check, we prompt the model to self-correct its reasoning. We adopt two variants (Base,
w LLMaJ): Base uses only verifier signals without LLMaJ premise evaluation, while V ERI C OT-w
LLMaJ leverages the full set of signals for self-reflection. Given all relevant information for every
step, including the original reasoning steps, any added premises, the corresponding formalizations,
errors, check results (with execution results and the model’s parameter assignment), and optional
LLMaJ premise evaluation, the model is prompted to revise its CoT reasoning during inference. This
generates an updated CoT, which is then re-evaluated.
Table 4 reports verification pass rates, verifier precision, verified correct answer rates (VCAR), and
final task accuracy after self-reflection, together with the corresponding improvements relative to
pre-reflection values (∆PR, ∆Precision, and ∆VCAR). Across all benchmarks, V ERI C OT with
self-reflection yields consistent gains in both coverage ( average +12.3%(absolute)/ +46.4% (relative))
and verified correct answer rate ( average +9.5%(absolute)/ +41.1% (relative)), indicating that
refinement encourages the generation of reasoning that is more frequently verifiable and leads to
correct answers. V ERI C OT achieves the highest absolute pass rates and verified correct answer rate,
while maintaining a similar level of precision and slightly better final task accuracy. These results

demands.need: 把结构化验证反馈作为同任务推理修正条件。

matches.reason: 原始输出与反馈后重新推理构成实际干预比较。
同一修正轨迹中，原推理步骤与验证反馈进入后续输入，再生成并重评；前后测单位为该修正轨迹，不把同题重跑自动视为真人被试内设计。

demands.need: 区分验证通过、实际答案正确与形式化误差。

matches.reason: 错误类型、通过率和任务准确率是并列结果。
逻辑错误通过符号化验证器定义。
验证器依赖自动形式化，接受率不是内部真实推理正确性的直接真值。

demands.need: 人审抽样按四标签均衡，保留其与自然错误分布的差别。

matches.reason: 人评20例/数据集为分层验证样本，不能代替全图类别分母。

limitations: ProofWriter反馈后通过率升而任务准确率下降，不称各指标全面改善；统一修正逐字模板、温度及多seed重复未报告。
